"''Why can't you be honest about your father for once?|Flix and Orka|audio=FlixsFather-DangerousBusiness.flac|}} The '''father''' of the [[Gozzo]] [[Flix]] was a [[Gender|male]] individual. Upon returning to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' after a visit to his{{BucketsList|E_DxK2LQKFM|#1.14: "Dangerous Business"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-dangerous-business-star-wars-resistance}} [[Flix's mother|mother]] in [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|1|13}} Flix claimed to his business partner, [[Orka]], that his [[Parent|father]] was part-[[Gungan]]. Orka rebuffed the claim due to Gungans lacking feathers, inquiring why he insisted on perpetuating untrue information about his [[Flix's flock|parent]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Flix claims to be part Gungan. He is actually a new alien species created for the show.|[[Andi Gutierrez]] on Bucket's List, about Flix's claims concerning his father's origins|}} Flix's father was first mentioned in "[[Dangerous Business]]," the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series.{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} The episode premiered on [[January 20]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Dangerous Business}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *{{BucketsList|E_DxK2LQKFM|#1.14: "Dangerous Business"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-dangerous-business-star-wars-resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Père de Flix |ka=ფლიქსის მამა }} [[Category:Flix's flock]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
